title: Ruleset: care
description: rules/<id>/care.yaml: the partner's care (docs/reference/care.md). Times in game minutes. A first version with a few constants; the partner system completes it.

baby_interval_hours.description: A baby is hungry every this many hours.

in_training_interval_hours.description: An in-training partner is hungry every this many hours.

window_minutes.description: How long the partner asks for food; unfed by then is a care mistake.

starving_weight_loss_minutes.description: With no energy left, the weight goes down 1 every this many minutes.

tiredness_percent_per_minute.description: Each minute this percent of the tiredness adds to the sleep counter.

tiredness_threshold.description: With the sleep counter at this, the time awake is cut and the counter starts again.

awake_cut_minutes.description: How much time awake each cut takes away.

quirks.description: The original's oddities: true reproduces the original, false fixes it.

sleeping_hungry_keeps_weight.description: Falling asleep hungry never costs weight: the hunger is cleared before it is checked.

sleep_adds_default_hours_to_evolution.description: Sleeping adds the default sleep hours to the evolution counter, however long the partner slept.
